Aaron, saw BlinkOps closed its $50M Series B and launched the No-Code Security Agent Builder amid 400% YoY growth.

Growth that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps and SEs ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for BlinkOps off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Aaron, quick follow-up for BlinkOps.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings BlinkOps needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

I pulled a benchmark of how BlinkOps's reply rate likely compares to other security software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
